messages.content: "根據'us_history.population_by_state_year'函數，1980年和1990年加州的人口數分別是多少？同樣地，根據'us_economy.gdp_by_state_year'函數，設定為'實際'，這些年份加州的實際GDP又是多少？"

function.name: us_economy_gdp_by_state_year

We need to call the function twice for population, once for each year. And call gdp function twice for each year with adjustment Real.

We should use the function calls. Probably we can combine? But the function signature expects one call per request. So we need separate calls.
